study: RevTrace Whisper cross-family and cross-scale closure

paper_identity.problem: batch-dependent numerical choices can enter feedback state and alter future revision trajectories
method: versioned transactional commit and stale-result rejection
deferred singleton authority for risky state and work-budget saturation

state_contract.projection: start-of-previous marker plus bounded raw generated-token suffix from all canonical-authorized or contract-admitted prior segments
state_contract.terminal_policy: terminal output has no successor feedback edge; it is governed by an independent paired target-quality contract, while a proposal that exhausts its smaller decoder budget is replaced by the extended singleton authority
state_contract.low_margin_policy: display batched text provisionally; singleton canonical owns future prompt-state entry
state_contract.capacity_rebase: discard prompt history before the declared next-segment budget would exceed the checkpoint-derived prompt bound
state_contract.state_entry_metric: nonterminal committed feedback transitions only; risky state and terminal stable output require deferred singleton authority
state_contract.revision_work_budget_semantics: the proposer may use a predeclared smaller decode cap, but exhausting that cap cannot define canonical state or output; an extended 96-step singleton authority selects the result, and prompt-history capacity is rebased against the target authority budget rather than the speculative budget

risk_contract.threshold_rule: per model and concurrency, select the lowest-cost contract-scoped frontier over decision margin, feedback-state age, and prior-prompt load whose one-sided 95% calibration upper risk is at most 0.5%, whose synchronous verification fraction is at most 20%, and which covers every adaptation-only root
risk_contract.renewal_rule: if an independent audit or repeat-stable post-timing replay catches an unsafe fast-path transition, reject that policy epoch, add the root to a contextual failure ledger, select a new margin-by-state-age-and-load frontier from frozen calibration data, and validate it on a new independent seed; never count adaptation rows as validation

excluded_epochs.202726: fail-closed repeat-stable base/c16 state-entry root; all completed rows excluded rather than seed-selected
excluded_epochs.202728: fail-closed repeat-stable base/c8 long-state root; all completed rows excluded rather than seed-selected

execution_order: cyclic Latin-square rotation across systems and seeds
claim_boundaries: The paper is a state-consistency method paper, not a Whisper optimization paper.
LocalAgreement protects display stability; RevTrace protects future model-state write authority.
Zero observed violations is not deterministic exactness and is reported with a time-uniform statistical bound.
The test suite does not estimate population prevalence of numerical divergence.

Formal W5 performance timing excludes post-timing validation. Every fast-path state write is replayed against the same-state singleton canonical; any first mismatch receives a same-input repeated-singleton control before attribution to the fast path.

Terminal output is never counted as future-state authority. Its quality is evaluated against the independently declared target-work contract; decoder-budget saturation always invokes extended singleton authority.
